query: I want to go to Tirthan Valley for trout fishing and riverside stays, 4 days, budget is $500.

expected_constraints.vibe_or_interests: trout fishing and riverside stays

ground_truth_facts: Tirthan Valley is located in Himachal Pradesh near the Great Himalayan National Park.
Trout fishing in Tirthan River requires angling permits from the local fisheries department.
Riverside homestays and cottages are situated near Gushaini and Nagini villages.
Key attractions include Chhoie Waterfall, Jalori Pass, and Serolsar Lake trek.

snapshotted_sources.title: Tirthan Valley Travel Guide - Trout Streams & GHNP
snapshotted_sources.text: Tirthan Valley in Himachal Pradesh is renowned for clear streams of the Tirthan River and trout fishing. Angling permits can be obtained from the Himachal Fisheries Department for ₹100-200. Riverside stays in Gushaini and Nagini offer rustic wooden rooms right along the riverbank.

snapshotted_sources.title: Great Himalayan National Park & Serolsar Lake Itinerary
snapshotted_sources.text: From Tirthan Valley, popular excursions include trekking to the Chhoie Waterfall, driving up to Jalori Pass at 3,120 meters, and hiking 5 km to the holy Serolsar Lake. Mid-range homestays cost ₹2,500 to ₹4,500 per night.

snapshotted_sources.text: Both Chikmagalur and Coorg offer sprawling Arabica and Robusta coffee estates, waterfalls like Abbey and Hebbe, and misty peaks like Mullayanagiri. Estate homestays provide estate walks and fresh filter coffee for ₹3,000/night.

snapshotted_sources.text: Udaipur, the City of Lakes, features iconic heritage palaces. Private motorboat charters on Lake Pichola cost ₹4,000-8,000. Rooftop dining at Ambrai or Upre overlooks the illuminated City Palace facade.

snapshotted_sources.text: Standard Ladakh 6-day itinerary requires Days 1-2 in Leh for altitude adaptation. Khardung La leads to Hunder's double-humped camel dunes. Direct route via Shyok River connects Nubra to Pangong Tso in 5 hours without returning to Leh. Inner Line Permits are booked via lahdclehpermit.in.

snapshotted_sources.text: Jaipur's iconic Amber Fort stands atop Cheel ka Teela with Rajput and Mughal architecture. Composite monument tickets cost ₹300-1000. snapshotted_sources.text: Jantar Mantar built by Maharaja Sawai Jai Singh II houses nineteen architectural astronomical instruments, including the Vrihat Samrat Yantra sundial. Early morning hot air balloon rides over the Aravalli hills provide sweeping views of Amber Fort and Jal Mahal.

query: 3-day white-water rafting and yoga retreat in Rishikesh with riverside camping under $350.

snapshotted_sources.text: Sunrise rowing boats from Assi to Dashashwamedh Ghat reveal morning bathers, sadhus, and centuries-old riverside palaces. Sanapur Lake across the river offers coracle boat rides (₹300) and bouldering crags with rental crash pads for ₹200/day.

query: 3-day wildlife safari in Kaziranga National Park Assam to spot one-horned rhinos, budget $500.

Jeep safaris operate twice daily (morning 7:30 AM and afternoon 1:30 PM) costing around ₹2,500-3,500 per jeep.
Tea garden homestays and eco-resorts near Kohora range cost ₹2,500 to ₹4,500 per night.

snapshotted_sources.title: Kaziranga Rhino Safari & Assam Travel Guide
snapshotted_sources.text: Kaziranga's Bagori western range is renowned for dense rhino populations and wild water buffaloes. Central Kohora range offers excellent birdwatching and swamp deer sightings. Open 4x4 Gypsy safaris must be booked through the range forest office. Surrounding Hathikuli and Diffalu tea estates offer heritage bungalow stays.

query: 4-day Tibetan culture and Triund trek in McLeod Ganj Dharamshala, budget $350.

query: 3-day rainforest treehouse stay and bamboo rafting in Wayanad Kerala under $400.

query: 4-day Parvati Valley backpacking trip to Kasol, Chalal, and Kheerganga hot springs trek, budget $300.

snapshotted_sources.title: Mirjan Fort and Gokarna Coastal Cruising
snapshotted_sources.text: Mirjan Fort built under Queen Chennabhairadevi (the Pepper Queen) features watchtowers, hidden passageways, and laterite stone architecture surrounded by lush coconut trees. Entry is free. Boat rides around Tadadi backwaters and Om Beach offer sunset views and occasional dolphin sightings for ₹400/person.
